name: dust

patches.old:
get_latest_version() {
    info "Fetching latest version..."
    
    # Try using curl
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        VERSION=$(curl -sSf "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/latest" | grep '"tag_name"' | sed -E 's/.*"v?([^"]+)".*/\1/')
    # Try using wget
    elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        VERSION=$(wget -qO- "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/latest" | grep '"tag_name"' | sed -E 's/.*"v?([^"]+)".*/\1/')
    else
        error "Neither curl nor wget is available. Please install one of them."
    fi
    
    if [ -z "$VERSION" ]; then
        error "Failed to fetch latest version"
    fi
    
    info "Latest version: v$VERSION"
}

# Download
    if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        curl -sSfL "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o "$ARCHIVE_NAME" || error "Download failed"
    elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        wget -q "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -O "$ARCHIVE_NAME" || error "Download failed"
    fi
patches.new:
# Read the pinned archive from this offline bundle.
    offline_fetch "$DOWNLOAD_URL" "$ARCHIVE_NAME" || error "Local resource unavailable"

cp "$BINARY_PATH" "$INSTALL_DIR/.dust.offline-new" || error "Installation failed"
        chmod +x "$INSTALL_DIR/.dust.offline-new"
        mv -f "$INSTALL_DIR/.dust.offline-new" "$INSTALL_DIR/dust" || error "Installation failed"

resources.checksum_source: locally-pinned after HTTPS download; not independent upstream verification

notes: Converts the official documented shell installation path with exact patches, pinned version and bundled resources.
Upstream source is fetched from a fixed Git commit at build time rather than vendored. Runtime software license remains upstream.
Creates the explicitly requested install directory before the upstream writability test; otherwise its user-prefix branch incorrectly tries sudo on a new directory.
Fixes reproduced upstream repeat-install Text file busy error by copying to a same-directory temporary binary and renaming over the old executable.
